question: Who is the new Chief Secretary of Uttar Pradesh? (August 2025)
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Shashi Prakash Goyal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Shashi Prakash Goyal Appointed New Chief Secretary of UP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Shashi Prakash Goyal**, a **1989-batch IAS officer**, is the new **Chief Secretary of Uttar Pradesh**.

 
 
• 
 
He earlier served as **Additional Chief Secretary** to the **Uttar Pradesh CM**.

 
 
• 
 
Held charge of **Civil Aviation**, **Estate**, and **Protocol departments**.

 
 
• 
 
Also served as **Additional Resident Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh**.

 
 
• 
 
He **succeeds Manoj Kumar Singh** in the top administrative post.

 
 
• 
 
Goyal brings experience from both **state-level administration** and **Delhi liaison roles**.
